landing.title: Study smarter with AI.
landing.subtitle: Upload your course PDFs and get auto-generated flashcards & interactive quizzes for active recall.
landing.heroSubtitle: Turn your PDF course materials into flashcards and quizzes — instantly.
landing.mockupDrop: Drag your PDF here, or browse
landing.mockupHint: Supports lecture slides, e-books, and PDF notes (max 15 MB)
landing.aboutTitle:
Stop passive reading.
Start active learning.
landing.aboutDesc: Yoohoo uses AI to extract key concepts from your lecture PDFs and transforms them into interactive flashcards and practice quizzes — so you can study smarter, not harder.
landing.feature1Desc: Drop any course PDF — slides, e-books, or notes. Our AI reads it and pulls out the most important concepts automatically.
landing.feature2Desc: Review key terms and definitions one by one with interactive flip cards. Perfect for memorization and active recall.
landing.feature3Desc: Test your understanding with AI-generated multiple choice questions. Get instant feedback and track your progress over time.
landing.feature4Desc: All your materials and quiz scores are saved. Revisit flashcards or retake quizzes anytime to reinforce your learning.
landing.socialHeroSubtitle: Yoohoo is a space to share knowledge, discover community-made material, and study with AI-powered flashcards and quizzes.
landing.socialMockupHint: Slides, e-books, or PDF notes up to 100 MB
landing.mockupFeedTitle: A feed for fresh ideas and material
landing.mockupPost: I just finished summarizing the basics of machine learning. Sharing the deck so we can study it together.
landing.socialAboutTitle: A social network that makes learning feel connected.
landing.socialAboutDesc: Yoohoo brings a learning community and personal study tools together. Share ideas, discover material from other learners, then open Your Desk when you want to focus with flashcards and quizzes.
landing.socialTitle: Knowledge means more when it is shared.
landing.socialDesc: Explore material and discussions from the community. Follow learners you like, discuss new ideas, and build better study habits together.
landing.socialFeature1Desc: Write a post, share material, or explain something new you have just learned.
landing.socialFeature2Desc: Explore posts, topics, and study decks shared by other learners.
landing.socialFeature3Desc: Follow other learners and interact through likes, comments, and reposts.
landing.socialFeature4Desc: Bookmark useful posts and material so you can return to them anytime.
landing.deskTitle: All your study material on one desk.
landing.deskDesc: Your Desk is a personal space for organizing study material. Upload a PDF, choose important concepts, and let AI turn them into flashcards and quizzes.
landing.deskFeature1Desc: Arrange material into decks so everything stays organized and easy to find.
landing.deskFeature2Desc: Study concepts with interactive cards designed for active recall.
landing.deskFeature3Desc: Test your understanding with multiple-choice questions based on your material.
landing.deskFeature4Desc: Review quiz results, past attempts, and material you need to revisit.
landing.stepsTitle: From material to understanding in three steps.
landing.stepsDesc: Yoohoo helps you break long material into focused study sessions that are easy to revisit.
landing.step1Desc: Upload lecture slides, e-books, modules, or PDF notes to Your Desk.
landing.step2Desc: Review important concepts extracted by AI, then select what you want to study.
landing.step3Desc: Review flashcards, continue with a quiz, then check your results and progress.
landing.shareTitle: Create once, help many people learn.
landing.shareDesc: Share a deck from Your Desk with the community. Other learners can study it or copy it into their own space.
landing.finalTitle: One place to connect, share, and learn.
landing.finalDesc: Discover knowledge from the community and turn your study material into flashcards and quizzes with Yoohoo.
